verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that CIPO's transactional capabilities (filing or amending trademarks, renewals, patent filing and maintenance) run through online services and MyCIPO account logins. The only programmatic-style access is downloadable bulk data and searchable databases, which are read-only data dumps and searches, not an API matching the UI. Nothing in the pack documents an API, let alone one with parity to the UI, so this applicable axis is unmet.
